mcqs.question: The Ancient Buddhist Site of Sarnath was inscribed under which combination of components and UNESCO criteria?
options: Chaukhandi Stupa and archaeological remains; criteria (iii) and (vi)
Chaukhandi Stupa and archaeological remains; criteria (i) and (iv)
Bateshwar, Padavali and Kakarmath; criteria (iii) and (vi)
Varaha and Anantasayana Vishnu sculptures; criteria (ii) and (v)
mcqs.explanation: The Ancient Buddhist Site of Sarnath comprises Chaukhandi Stupa and archaeological remains and was inscribed under criteria (iii) and (vi). The Bateshwar, Padavali and Kakarmath group belongs to the Chambal Valley entry, not Sarnath.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is an example of a property on the World Heritage in Danger list?
mcqs.explanation: Bamiyan Valley is one of the examples of properties on the World Heritage in Danger list. Zabid and Bam are also examples, whereas Sarnath is not included among the listed examples.

mcqs.question:
Match List-I with List-II regarding the Satyagraha sites included in India's UNESCO Tentative List.

List-I
(a) Pietermaritzburg Railway Station
(b) Phoenix Settlement
(c) Sabarmati Ashram
(d) Mani Bhavan

List-II
i. South Africa
ii. India
iii. South Africa
iv. India
mcqs.explanation: Pietermaritzburg Railway Station and Phoenix Settlement are the South African components, while Sabarmati Ashram and Mani Bhavan are Indian components. Therefore, the correct pairs are a-i, b-iii, c-ii and d-iv.

mcqs.question: Which of the following statements regarding Gandhi Jayanti is incorrect?
options: It is one of India's three national holidays.
A memorial associated with Gandhi Jayanti is located at Rajghat.
It is one of India's two national holidays.
The other two national holidays are Republic Day and Independence Day.
mcqs.explanation: Gandhi Jayanti is one of India's three national holidays, along with Republic Day and Independence Day, and its memorial is at Rajghat. The incorrect statement changes the number of national holidays from three to two.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements about Mahatma Gandhi:

1. Karamchand Gandhi was his father and served as a Diwan.
2. Putlibai was his mother.
3. He married Kasturba in 1883 and had sons Harilal, Manilal, Ramdas and Devdas.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
mcqs.explanation: All three statements are correct: Karamchand Gandhi was the Diwan and Gandhi's father, Putlibai was his mother, and Gandhi married Kasturba in 1883. The tempting option '1 and 3 only' is incorrect because it omits the correct statement about Putlibai.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:

Statement A: Hind Swaraj, written in 1909, is listed among Gandhi's works.
Statement B: Satyagraha, Ahimsa, Swaraj, Sarvodaya, Trusteeship and Swadeshi are listed among Gandhi's ideas.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are true. Hind Swaraj is listed as a work from 1909, while Satyagraha, Ahimsa, Swaraj, Sarvodaya, Trusteeship and Swadeshi are listed as Gandhi's ideas.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is listed as a work of Mahatma Gandhi?
mcqs.explanation: Hind Swaraj, written in 1909, is listed among Gandhi's works. Satyagraha, Trusteeship and Swadeshi are listed as ideas rather than as the works identified here.
